test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states receives the maximum rainfall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam​.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam **state receives the maximum rainfall.
 
• Assam state of India consists of** two hill districts and twenty-one plain districts.**
 
• During the monsoon season, whenever moisture-laden southerly or south-westerly winds coming from the Bay of Bengal in south, hit the east-west oriented mountain ranges.
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, and Meghalaya** receive more rainfall in comparison to other States of the north-eastern region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mawsynram is referred to as the rainiest place in the world.
 
• It receives nearly 10,000 millimeters of rain in an average year.
 
 
• Mawsynram is located in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya.
 
• It is on the windward side of the hills and is surrounded by hills on three sides.
 
• It receives rain from southwest monsoon winds (Bay of Bengal branch), as the winds cannot move further striking the hills and due to condensation receives heavy rainfall.
